world.description: World-level tunables read by engine/world (bytes injected by platform/config). All keys required; platform/config validates this block before calling world.New so a missing key is caught at startup (D10).

spatial_hash_cell.description: SpatialHash cell edge in world units; choose ≈ avg perception radius for best locality.

outcome_difficulty_base.description: The Real Stat level at which an action resolves as Succeeded under neutral (no effort/risk modifier) conditions.

backup_every_ticks.description: Emit SnapshotReady every N ticks; platform/persist handles the actual write.

plan_interval.description: Plan-interval: agents per planning slice; 1 = all agents plan every tick. Higher values spread planner load across ticks.

prune_threshold.description: Max ticks since LastSeen before ToM beliefs are pruned; 0 = never prune (current behavior).

arrival_epsilon.description: Locomotion (MoveTo/Approach) completes when the agent is within this distance of its destination; travel time then scales with distance (engine/world). Optional — defaults to 1.0 when absent.

needs.description: Per-need rate constants read by engine/needs (the bytes are injected by platform/config — engine/needs never reads a file path, D10). Keys are canonical Dimension ids from docs/glossary.md (Satiety, Hydration, Rest, Safety, Standing, Openness, …) and are cross-checked against content/needs.yaml by platform/config. This is the AUTHORITATIVE source of the per-need rate/threshold for consumable needs: 'decay_per_tick' is the per-tick (= per game-minute) satisfaction loss (D9: rate only — demand = rate × predicted-time is DERIVED by the planner, never authored), and 'satisfaction_threshold' is the setpoint in [0,1] below which the need is unmet. Conditional, non-time-driven needs (content/needs.yaml kind:conditional, rate 0) are NOT listed here — additionalProperties below forbids a zero/absent decay.

decay_per_tick.description: Satisfaction lost per tick (= per game-minute). Strictly positive; a need that does not drift with time is a conditional need (content/needs.yaml kind:conditional) and is not listed here.

satisfaction_threshold.description: Setpoint in [0,1]; below this the need is unmet and raises salience.

values.description: Value-arbitration tuning read by engine/values (bytes injected by platform/config — engine/values never reads a file path, D10). Currently a per-Dimension weight map used by Priority(d) = Salience(d) × weight(d). These weights bias WHICH need an agent pursues next; they NEVER select or order actions (that is the planner, D5).

weights.description: Per-Dimension weight ≥ 0. Keys are canonical Dimension ids (docs/glossary.md); platform/config cross-checks each against content/needs.yaml. A Dimension absent here defaults to weight 1.0 in engine/values.

collective_aggregation_mode.description: Aggregation mode for Collective referent evaluation: 'mean' or 'min'.

planner.description: Deliberation-engine tunables read by engine/planner (bytes injected by platform/config — engine/planner never reads a file path, D10). Distinct from the 'planning' block, which holds engine/agent's cross-tick budget-scaling + anti-thrash stickiness/deadband; the planner reads ONLY this block. Provides the HTN/GOAP search caps (budget.*), the forward-sim base lookahead (base_horizon_ticks; the Intelligence-gated horizon is floor(base_horizon_ticks × perceived_intelligence / max_intelligence), min 1 tick, D9), the per-Tag additive cost weights (tag_costs; cost(action) = Σ tag_costs[tag], D4 — the cost channel transferred out of engine/gates at schema_version 2), and the urgency relaxation trigger (urgency_threshold; a gated action becomes visible iff Urgency exceeds it — conscience loosening).

budget.description: Hard search caps; a breach aborts the Plan call with ErrBudgetExceeded (no silent truncation, so a why-trace can record the abort).

max_depth.description: Max HTN recursion depth (precondition-chain ceiling; prevents infinite loops).

max_actions.description: Max assembled plan length (actions in the sequence).

max_nodes.description: Max GOAP nodes expanded per Plan call.

base_horizon_ticks.description: Base forward-sim lookahead in ticks (= game-minutes). The effective horizon is Intelligence-gated: floor(base_horizon_ticks × perceived_intelligence / max_intelligence), with a minimum of 1 tick when perceived Intelligence is 0.

urgency_threshold.description: Dynamic-visibility relaxation trigger in [0,1]: a normally-invisible (gated) action becomes available for one Plan call iff Urgency (max Salience across all Dimensions) exceeds this (conscience loosening).

tag_costs.description: Per-Tag additive cost weight ≥ 0 (D4). cost(action) = Σ tag_costs[tag] over the action's tags; a tag absent here contributes 0. Used as the tie-breaker among equal-Priority, equal-depth candidates (lower cost wins; remaining ties break by lexicographic ActionID, D12). Keys are core.Tag strings; platform/config cross-checks each against the tags actually used in content/actions.yaml.

intelligence.description: Intelligence-gated branch thresholds (P5). Perceived Intelligence is normalized to [0,1] (ToM[self] Intelligence / max stat, D8) and read by three modules — engine/planner (lookahead), engine/agent (rebind), engine/values (other-referent). Bytes injected by platform/config (D10).

lookahead_threshold.description: engine/planner: perceived Intelligence below this skips forward-sim entirely (no provisioning subgoals); at/above, the gradual horizon formula applies.

rebind_threshold.description: engine/agent: perceived Intelligence below this skips Rebinding and goes straight to Latent (D8 object-fixation). Supersedes the deprecated coping.rebind_min_intelligence.

other_intel_threshold.description: engine/values: perceived Intelligence below this makes the Other-referent use the mood proxy; at/above it uses the unmet-need estimate.

social.description: Social bond tunables (P5). Read by engine/agent for Other-referent bond multiplier and care threshold.

bond_affinity_gain.description: Multiplier applied to base weight: 1 + Affinity * bond_affinity_gain.

min_care_threshold.description: Affinity threshold above which an Other is considered cared-for.

politics.description: Emergent institutions/politics tunables (P6). Reliance (RelyOn) accretion, delegation Votes, role-cluster detection, and social Influence. A role is the emergent RelyOn cluster over a Function — there is NO role type (D2). Read by engine/world (role_convergence_threshold) + engine/agent (the rest).

role_convergence_threshold.description: Share of agents relying on one holder for a Function → engine/world emits RoleEmerged on the rising edge. Supersedes the retired world.reliance_threshold.

influence_weight.description: Reflection ratio: signalWeight = trust·(1 + influence_weight·Influence). 0 disables Influence weighting.

rely_cost_threshold.description: Plan cost above which a Function counts self-unsolvable, forming a RelyOn edge.

relyon_delta.description: RelyOn[function] increment toward the chosen provider on a self-failure.

vote_rely_threshold.description: Private reliance strength that licenses emitting a Vote.

vote_urgency_threshold.description: Distributed urgency threshold above which an agent emits a Vote (combined urgency proxy).

vote_relyon_delta.description: RelyOn increment a heard Vote folds into the receiver toward the voted holder.

threats.description: Threat-perception tunables (P5/P6 BLOCKER-1). Read by engine/agent for hostile-tag detection; platform/config resolves hostile_tags into Config.ThreatTags. engine/agent never branches on a tag literal (D10). The per_threat_intensity and safety_decay fields parameterise the conditional Safety-intensity driver (engine/needs.Def.UpdateConditionalNeeds).

hostile_tags.description: core.Tag strings on a perceived signal/entity that trigger a defensive Safety-goal insertion (engine/agent phase 1).

safety_threat_threshold.description: When the collective Safety mean drops below this, a defensive (Patrol) goal fires (engine/agent collective appraisal, P5).

per_threat_intensity.description: P6 BLOCKER-1: Safety intensity added per perceived threat, injected into needs.UpdateConditionalNeeds (balance.yaml threats.per_threat_intensity).

safety_decay.description: P6 BLOCKER-1: Safety intensity removed per tick when no threat is perceived, injected into needs.UpdateConditionalNeeds (balance.yaml threats.safety_decay).

trade.description: Trade-signal tunables (P5). Read by engine/agent when emitting an Offer signal; bytes injected by platform/config (D10). The deceptive-claim band: a fully-honest agent (perceived Honesty = 1, D8 reads ToM[self]) claims claim_inflate_min; a fully-dishonest agent (perceived Honesty = 0) inflates to claim_inflate_max. claimed = min + (1 − honesty)·(max − min).

claim_inflate_min.description: Claim floor: the ClaimedValue an agent with perceived Honesty = 1 offers (no inflation).

claim_inflate_max.description: Claim ceiling: the ClaimedValue an agent with perceived Honesty = 0 offers (maximum inflation); must be ≥ claim_inflate_min.
